fields.description: ResourceAdministrativeStateType enumerations; values defined by ITU X.731: 'locked': The resource is administratively prohibited from performing services for its users; 'shutdown': Use of the resource is administratively permitted to existing instances of use only. fields.description: The measurement job creation time.

fields.description: Possible values for the state of the execution

fields.name: jobId
fields.description: The ID of the management job.

fields.name: jobPriority
fields.description: The priority of the management job. The way the management application will use the JobPriority to schedule job execution is application specific and outside the scope. Integer, limited to a range of 1 to 10.

fields.name: lastModifiedTime
fields.description: The last time that a measurement job was modified.

fields.name: consumingApplicationId
fields.description: The identifier of the application that consumes performance indicators.

fields.name: producingApplicationId
fields.description: The identifier of the application that produces performance indicators.

fields.name: granularity
fields.description: Sampling rate of the collection or production of performance indicators.

fields.name: reportingPeriod
fields.description: Possible values for the reporting period

fields.name: jobOnDemand
fields.description: True if the job is a single job to be executed immediately in which case the reportingPeriod and scheduleDefinition would not be applicable, false otherwise
